span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Glutamatergic alvear terminals in stratum oriens excite local interneurons, which in turn hyperpolarize CA1 pyramidal cells through GABA-A receptors, so the net effect of the pathway on pyramidal cells is inhibition rather than excitation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Rhythmic burst firing of alvear-driven PV perisomatic interneurons imposes rhythmic perisomatic inhibition on pyramidal cells, which the authors propose as a contribution to theta rhythm generation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the excitatory input onto pyramidal cells is monosynaptic but too weak to reach threshold even under theta burst stimulation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: while the same input drives interneurons to fire, and the inhibition arriving at PC is therefore disynaptic
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with parvalbumin cells doing more than half of it, shown by silencing them during the stimulation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and both sets of synapses facilitating, which marks them as low release probability
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Most recorded stratum oriens interneurons could not be anatomically classified because biocytin fills were insufficient.
span.note: what this limits: every result reported by interneuron type: NONE OF THESE 13 NEURONS HAD SUFFICIENT AXONAL FILL TO PERMIT ANATOMICAL IDENTIFICATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Whether the theta-coherent MEC layer 2 pyramidal cells actually contribute to the alvear pathway is unknown, weakening the proposed link to theta rhythm generation.
span.note: what this limits: the link between the theta-coherent MEC L2 pyramidal cells and this pathway: IT IS UNKNOWN WHETHER THESE MEC L2 PCs CONTRIBUTE TO THE ALVEAR PATHWAY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The relative strength of the temporo-ammonic and alvear pathways cannot be settled from earlier work.
span.note: what this limits: any ranking of the two pathways by strength: A DIRECT COMPARISON BETWEEN THE STRENGTHS OF TA AND ALVEAR INPUTS WAS NOT POSSIBLE WITH PREVIOUS STUDIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether the recently identified projection neurons that fire with theta actually contribute to this pathway is unknown

span.label: A MAJOR INPUT PATHWAY WITH NO PHYSIOLOGY ATTACHED TO IT: the alvear pathway is a MAJOR EXCITATORY INPUT to hippocampal CA1, YET NOTHING IS KNOWN ABOUT ITS PHYSIOLOGICAL IMPACT
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and it is not a minor route - in rodent it CARRIES MOST of the entorhinal input to dorsal CA1, and its effect on the postsynaptic neurons HAS NOT, TO OUR KNOWLEDGE, BEEN REPORTED

span.label: THE REGION STUDIED WAS CHOSEN BY THE TOOLS THAT EXISTED: the medial entorhinal cortex was chosen as the viral expression target BY VIRTUE OF THE TRANSGENIC MICE AVAILABLE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A DISAGREEMENT DIVIDED BY PREPARATION: SOME GROUPS observed monosynaptic suprathreshold activation after stimulation in vivo, WHEREAS OTHER GROUPS observed only subthreshold events
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the in vitro literature does not disagree with itself at all - ex vivo stimulation has CONSISTENTLY been found to give subthreshold responses, so the preparation is what the disagreement turns on
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE COMPARISON EVERYONE WOULD WANT COULD NOT BE MADE BEFORE, AND THE PAPER SAYS WHY: stimulating the distal layer activates the other pathway, this pathway's own distal terminals, AND a thalamic input, so A DIRECT COMPARISON BETWEEN THE STRENGTHS OF THE TWO WAS NOT POSSIBLE WITH PREVIOUS STUDIES
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME TARGET REGION, TWO INPUTS, DIFFERENT INTERNEURON SUBSETS: parvalbumin cells produce LITTLE TO NO RESPONSE to distal-layer stimulation and fire strongly to this one, so the two inputs ACTIVATE DIFFERENT SUBSETS OF INTERNEURONS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the selectivity was already known for the other pathway - specific subsets can be POTENTLY ACTIVATED while others are ONLY WEAKLY AFFECTED OR NOT AFFECTED AT ALL
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: NOT ALL SUBTYPES ARE EQUALLY AFFECTED: parvalbumin cells fire at higher frequencies than the other two classes, and the responsive cells span several morphological subtypes within each class
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME PHARMACOLOGICAL TEST GIVES OPPOSITE ANSWERS FOR THE TWO RESPONSE TYPES: the potassium channel blocker rescues the excitatory response and CANNOT rescue the inhibitory one, which is what makes one monosynaptic and the other disynaptic
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with a geometric argument doing the work the pharmacology cannot - the light was confined to the deep layers, so the terminals there MUST be the source and not the distal ones
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and a delay difference used the same way - the interneuron delay is SIGNIFICANTLY SHORTER than the pyramidal one, which is the wrong direction for a relayed response
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: MORE THAN HALF THE INHIBITION MEASURED RATHER THAN ATTRIBUTED: silencing one interneuron class during the same stimulation removed GREATER THAN 50% of the response amplitude
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE UNTESTED PATHWAY IS THE VULNERABLE ONE: tau accumulates in the terminals of THIS pathway BUT NOT the other, so the input nobody had recorded from may be the one that fails first in Alzheimer's disease
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with an open question left open - it is UNKNOWN whether the projection neurons whose firing tracks theta contribute to this pathway at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
